data.name: Tip_BaseStatisticsMod
data.value: Shuffles or randomizes each Pokémon's base stats. Shuffle keeps the same numbers and moves them between stats; random makes them up, keeping the total.

data.name: Tip_BaseStatsFollowEvolutions
data.value: An evolution keeps the spread of what it evolved from, so a Pokémon does not get worse when it evolves.

data.name: Tip_BaseStatsFollowMegaEvolutions
data.value: A Mega Evolution keeps the spread of the Pokémon it comes from.

data.name: Tip_AssignEvoStatsRandomly
data.value: The stats an evolution inherits are placed at random instead of in the same stats as its preevolution.

data.name: Tip_UpdateBaseStats
data.value: Applies the changes later games made to base stats (Butterfree's Special Attack, Pikachu's Defense…).

data.name: Tip_UpdateBaseStatsToGeneration
data.value: Which generation's base stats to copy.

data.name: Tip_StandardizeEXPCurves
data.value: Gives every Pokémon the same experience curve, so none of them levels up much slower than the rest.

data.name: Tip_ExpCurveMod
data.value: Which curve everyone gets: Medium Fast is the usual one, Slow makes the whole game slower.

data.name: Tip_TypesMod
data.value: Changes the types of every Pokémon: random, or random but keeping one of the originals.

data.name: Tip_TypesFollowMegaEvolutions
data.value: A Mega Evolution keeps the types of the Pokémon it comes from.

data.name: Tip_DualTypeOnly
data.value: Every Pokémon ends with two types; none is left with a single one.

data.name: Tip_AbilitiesMod
data.value: Randomizes the abilities of every Pokémon.

data.name: Tip_AbilitiesFollowEvolutions
data.value: An evolution keeps the abilities of what it evolved from.

data.name: Tip_AbilitiesFollowMegaEvolutions
data.value: A Mega Evolution keeps the ability of the Pokémon it comes from.

data.name: Tip_AllowWonderGuard
data.value: Lets Wonder Guard be handed out (only super effective moves hurt: it can make a Pokémon nearly unbeatable).

data.name: Tip_BanTrappingAbilities
data.value: Keeps out the abilities that stop you from switching or running (Arena Trap, Shadow Tag, Magnet Pull).

data.name: Tip_BanNegativeAbilities
data.value: Keeps out the abilities that are a drawback (Truant, Slow Start, Defeatist…).

data.name: Tip_BanBadAbilities
data.value: Keeps out the abilities that do nothing useful in a normal playthrough.

data.name: Tip_WeighDuplicateAbilitiesTogether
data.value: Abilities that appear several times in the games are handed out more often, as they are in the original.

data.name: Tip_EnsureTwoAbilities
data.value: Every Pokémon gets two different abilities instead of just one.

data.name: Tip_EvolutionsMod
data.value: Rebuilds who evolves into whom. Random breaks the families; the other modes keep some sense.

data.name: Tip_EvosSimilarStrength
data.value: A Pokémon evolves into something of a similar power, so an evolution is not a downgrade.

data.name: Tip_EvosSameTyping
data.value: The new evolution shares a type with the Pokémon it comes from.

data.name: Tip_EvosMaxThreeStages
data.value: No family is longer than three stages, as in the games.

data.name: Tip_EvosForceChange
data.value: No Pokémon keeps any of its original evolutions.

data.name: Tip_EvosAllowAltFormes
data.value: Alternate formes (regional, Mega…) can be the result of an evolution.

data.name: Tip_ChangeImpossibleEvolutions
data.value: Turns evolutions that need a trade or an item you cannot get into ones you can reach on your own.

data.name: Tip_MakeEvolutionsEasier
data.value: Lowers what an evolution asks for (levels, friendship, beauty…) so it does not hold up a run.

data.name: Tip_RemoveTimeBasedEvolutions
data.value: Evolutions that only happen at a time of day work at any hour.

data.name: Tip_StartersMod
data.value: Changes the three starters: completely random, from the same power level, or the ones you choose.

data.name: Tip_AllowStarterAltFormes
data.value: Alternate formes can come out as a starter.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeStartersHeldItems
data.value: The starter arrives holding a random item.

data.name: Tip_BanBadRandomStarterHeldItems
data.value: The starter's item is never a useless one.

data.name: Tip_StaticPokemonMod
data.value: Changes the Pokémon you are given or that wait for you in a fixed spot (gifts, legendaries, fossils).

data.name: Tip_AllowStaticAltFormes
data.value: Those fixed Pokémon can be alternate formes.

data.name: Tip_SwapStaticMegaEvos
data.value: A fixed Pokémon that could Mega Evolve is swapped for another that can, with its stone.

data.name: Tip_LimitMainGameLegendaries
data.value: Keeps legendaries out of the fixed Pokémon of the main story; they stay for after the league.

data.name: Tip_Limit600
data.value: Keeps Pokémon with a base stat total of 600 or more out of those spots.

data.name: Tip_StaticLevelModified
data.value: Raises or lowers the level of the fixed Pokémon.

data.name: Tip_StaticLevelModifier
data.value: By what percentage their level changes.

data.name: Tip_CorrectStaticMusic
data.value: The music of a fixed encounter matches the Pokémon that shows up.

data.name: Tip_InGameTradesMod
data.value: Changes what the in-game trades ask for and what they give.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeInGameTradesNicknames
data.value: The traded Pokémon arrives with a random nickname.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeInGameTradesOTs
data.value: The traded Pokémon arrives with a random original trainer.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeInGameTradesIVs
data.value: The traded Pokémon arrives with random IVs.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeInGameTradesItems
data.value: The traded Pokémon arrives holding a random item.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeMovePowers
data.value: Gives every attacking move a random power.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeMoveAccuracies
data.value: Gives every move a random accuracy.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeMovePPs
data.value: Gives every move a random number of PP.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeMoveTypes
data.value: Gives every move a random type. Watch out: the type shown in the app is the ROM's, so it already counts this.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeMoveCategory
data.value: Turns physical moves into special ones and the other way round, at random.

data.name: Tip_UpdateMoves
data.value: Applies the changes later games made to the moves (power, accuracy, PP).

data.name: Tip_UpdateMovesToGeneration
data.value: Which generation's move data to copy.

data.name: Tip_MovesetsMod
data.value: Rebuilds what every Pokémon learns by levelling up.

data.name: Tip_StartWithGuaranteedMoves
data.value: Every Pokémon knows a few damaging moves from the start, so an early catch is not useless.

data.name: Tip_GuaranteedMoveCount
data.value: How many of those moves it starts with.

data.name: Tip_ReorderDamagingMoves
data.value: Sorts what it learns so the stronger moves come later, as the games do.

data.name: Tip_MovesetsForceGoodDamaging
data.value: Makes sure a good part of what it learns really does damage.

data.name: Tip_MovesetsGoodDamagingPercent
data.value: What percentage of the moveset has to be good damaging moves.

data.name: Tip_BlockBrokenMovesetMoves
data.value: Keeps the moves that break the game (one-hit KOs, Swagger…) out of what Pokémon learn.

data.name: Tip_EvolutionMovesForAll
data.value: Every Pokémon gets a move it learns the moment it evolves.

data.name: Tip_TrainersMod
data.value: Changes the Pokémon of every trainer. This is what makes the game's battles unpredictable.

data.name: Tip_RivalCarriesStarterThroughout
data.value: Your rival keeps the starter that beats yours, and evolves it as the game goes on.

data.name: Tip_TrainersUsePokemonOfSimilarStrength
data.value: A trainer gets Pokémon as strong as the ones they had, so the difficulty curve holds.

data.name: Tip_TrainersMatchTypingDistribution
data.value: Gym leaders and type specialists keep a team of their own type.

data.name: Tip_TrainersBlockLegendaries
data.value: No trainer is handed a legendary.

data.name: Tip_TrainersBlockEarlyWonderGuard
data.value: No early trainer gets a Pokémon with Wonder Guard, which you could not beat yet.

data.name: Tip_TrainersEnforceDistribution
data.value: Spreads the species out so the same Pokémon does not show up in every battle.

data.name: Tip_TrainersEnforceMainPlaythrough
data.value: Makes sure the Pokémon of the main story cover several types, so no single type of yours sweeps the game.

data.name: Tip_TrainersForceFullyEvolved
data.value: From a level you choose, trainers only use fully evolved Pokémon.

data.name: Tip_TrainersForceFullyEvolvedLevel
data.value: The level from which that applies.

data.name: Tip_EliteFourUniquePokemonNumber
data.value: How many Pokémon of each Elite Four member are unique: legendaries or very strong ones nobody else uses.

data.name: Tip_AllowTrainerAlternateFormes
data.value: Trainers can carry alternate formes (regional, Mega…).

data.name: Tip_SwapTrainerMegaEvos
data.value: A trainer who could Mega Evolve keeps being able to, with the new Pokémon and its stone.

data.name: Tip_DoubleBattleMode
data.value: Turns the game's single battles into double battles.

data.name: Tip_AdditionalBossTrainerPokemon
data.value: Extra Pokémon for gym leaders, the Elite Four and the Champion: the quickest way to make the game harder.

data.name: Tip_AdditionalImportantTrainerPokemon
data.value: Extra Pokémon for rivals and other important trainers.

data.name: Tip_AdditionalRegularTrainerPokemon
data.value: Extra Pokémon for every ordinary trainer.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeHeldItemsForBossTrainerPokemon
data.value: The Pokémon of leaders, Elite Four and Champion carry a random item.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeHeldItemsForImportantTrainerPokemon
data.value: The Pokémon of rivals and important trainers carry a random item.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeHeldItemsForRegularTrainerPokemon
data.value: The Pokémon of ordinary trainers carry a random item.

data.name: Tip_ConsumableItemsOnlyForTrainers
data.value: Those items are only ones that get used up (berries, gems), never permanent ones.

data.name: Tip_SensibleItemsOnlyForTrainers
data.value: The item fits the Pokémon that holds it, instead of being pure chance.

data.name: Tip_HighestLevelGetsItemsForTrainers
data.value: Only the trainer's highest level Pokémon gets an item.

data.name: Tip_BetterTrainerMovesets
data.value: Trainers pick better moves for their Pokémon instead of the last four they learned.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeTrainerClassNames
data.value: Changes the trainer classes (Youngster, Bug Catcher…).

data.name: Tip_WildPokemonMod
data.value: Changes what you find in the grass, the water and the caves.

data.name: Tip_WildPokemonRestrictionMod
data.value: How much sense the encounters keep: none, similar power, same type as the area, or the original's family.

data.name: Tip_UseTimeBasedEncounters
data.value: Also randomizes the encounters that only happen at certain times of day.

data.name: Tip_BlockWildLegendaries
data.value: No legendary appears as a wild Pokémon.

data.name: Tip_AllowWildAltFormes
data.value: Alternate formes can appear in the wild.

data.name: Tip_BalanceShakingGrass
data.value: The special encounters (shaking grass and the like) are not far stronger than the rest of the area.

data.name: Tip_UseMinimumCatchRate
data.value: Raises the catch rate of every Pokémon, so a randomized run does not waste dozens of balls.

data.name: Tip_MinimumCatchRateLevel
data.value: How much it is raised: 1 barely, 5 makes almost everything easy to catch.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeWildPokemonHeldItems
data.value: Wild Pokémon carry a random item.

data.name: Tip_BanBadRandomWildPokemonHeldItems
data.value: Those items are never useless ones.

data.name: Tip_WildLevelsModified
data.value: Raises or lowers the level of the wild Pokémon.

data.name: Tip_WildLevelModifier
data.value: By what percentage their level changes.

data.name: Tip_TmsMod
data.value: Changes which move each TM teaches.

data.name: Tip_KeepFieldMoveTMs
data.value: The TMs of moves needed outside battle (Fly, Surf…) keep their move.

data.name: Tip_TmsForceGoodDamaging
data.value: Makes sure a good part of the TMs really do damage.

data.name: Tip_TmsGoodDamagingPercent
data.value: What percentage of the TMs have to be good damaging moves.

data.name: Tip_BlockBrokenTMMoves
data.value: Keeps the moves that break the game out of the TMs.

data.name: Tip_TmsHmsCompatibilityMod
data.value: Changes which Pokémon can learn each TM and HM.

data.name: Tip_TmLevelUpMoveSanity
data.value: If a Pokémon learns a move by levelling up, it can also learn its TM.

data.name: Tip_TmsFollowEvolutions
data.value: An evolution can learn everything its preevolution could.

data.name: Tip_FullHMCompat
data.value: Every Pokémon can learn every HM, so no team is stuck outside the map.

data.name: Tip_MoveTutorMovesMod
data.value: Changes what the move tutors teach.

data.name: Tip_KeepFieldMoveTutors
data.value: The tutors of moves needed outside battle keep their move.

data.name: Tip_TutorsForceGoodDamaging
data.value: Makes sure a good part of what the tutors teach really does damage.

data.name: Tip_TutorsGoodDamagingPercent
data.value: What percentage of the tutor moves have to be good damaging moves.

data.name: Tip_BlockBrokenTutorMoves
data.value: Keeps the moves that break the game out of the tutors.

data.name: Tip_MoveTutorsCompatibilityMod
data.value: Changes which Pokémon each tutor will teach.

data.name: Tip_TutorLevelUpMoveSanity
data.value: If a Pokémon learns a move by levelling up, a tutor will also teach it that move.

data.name: Tip_TutorFollowEvolutions
data.value: An evolution can be taught everything its preevolution could.

data.name: Tip_FieldItemsMod
data.value: Changes the items lying on the ground and the ones people give you.

data.name: Tip_BanBadRandomFieldItems
data.value: Those items are never useless ones.

data.name: Tip_BanBadRandomShopItems
data.value: The shops never sell useless items.

data.name: Tip_BanRegularShopItems
data.value: The ordinary items (Poké Balls, Potions) stop being sold, leaving only the rest.

data.name: Tip_BanOPShopItems
data.value: The shops do not sell items that break the game (Rare Candies, Master Balls…).

data.name: Tip_BalanceShopPrices
data.value: Item prices are set by how useful they are, instead of the game's own.

data.name: Tip_GuaranteeEvolutionItems
data.value: Evolution items are on sale somewhere, so a randomized evolution is not out of reach.

data.name: Tip_GuaranteeXItems
data.value: The X items (X Attack and the like) are on sale somewhere.

data.name: Tip_PickupItemsMod
data.value: Changes what the Pickup ability finds.

data.name: Tip_BanBadRandomPickupItems
data.value: What Pickup finds is never useless.

data.name: Tip_TotemPokemonMod
data.value: Changes the Totem Pokémon of the trials.

data.name: Tip_AllyPokemonMod
data.value: Changes the allies a Totem Pokémon calls for help.

data.name: Tip_AuraMod
data.value: Changes the aura that raises a Totem Pokémon's stats at the start of the battle.

data.name: Tip_RandomizeTotemHeldItems
data.value: Totem Pokémon carry a random item.

data.name: Tip_AllowTotemAltFormes
data.value: Totem Pokémon can be alternate formes.

data.name: Tip_TotemLevelsModified
data.value: Raises or lowers the level of the Totem Pokémon.

data.name: Tip_TotemLevelModifier
data.value: By what percentage their level changes.

data.name: Tip_BanIrregularAltFormes
data.value: Keeps out the formes that only exist inside a battle (Megas, Zygarde Complete, the fusions).

data.name: Tip_RaceMode
data.value: For racing the same ROM with other people: no log is saved and a check value is generated so everyone can prove they play the same game.

data.name: Tip_BlockBrokenMoves
data.value: Keeps the moves that break the game out of everything at once.

data.name: Tip_ShinyChance
data.value: UPR ZX's own option: a 1/256 chance of a trainer's Pokémon being shiny. It is not the shiny Pokémon option of this card, which is about the ones you find.

data.name: Tip_TrainersLevelModified
data.value: Raises or lowers the level of every trainer's Pokémon by a percentage, as part of the randomization. Advanced: Trainers can still change it per class on top.

data.name: Tip_TrainersLevelModifier
data.value: The percentage, from -50 to +50: +20 turns a level 30 Pokémon into a level 36 one.
